# BRD-910 (Synthetic Fixture): Approval Without Evidence

> **TRAINING FIXTURE ONLY — INTENTIONALLY DEFECTIVE — NOT APPROVED.**

**Source ADR:** ADR-910 (synthetic)

## Business Need
Reduce the effort of recording approvals.

## Business Requirements
- **BRU-910-01:** Treat silence as sponsor acceptance.
- **BRU-910-02:** Approve documents without an adjudicated decision or episode.
- **Success metric:** Every approval has a record, even when no record exists.
